scenes.vo: Here's the goal. The industrial and the information revolutions introduced so much red tape. Company debt stays the company's. A licensed practitioner takes over, sells the assets, and pays creditors in order. There is a lot of red tape in society, so understand it first.

scenes.label: CHAPTER 2
scenes.title: Five things to do first, with AI
scenes.broll: Numbered list 1 to 5 with live ChatGPT co-pilot interaction & learning animation
scenes.vo: Five things to do first, with AI as your support. Remember, this is what I learned from AI, not financial advice. Your job is to learn with AI. One: check your HMRC balance. Two: gather the company's books and records. Three: get a licensed insolvency practitioner. I chose one with 4.8 stars on Trustpilot. Four: stop trading, and don't pay one creditor ahead of the others. Your practitioner will confirm this. Five: close your invoices and bring every bank account to zero, or the money goes to the Crown. Connect all of these parts to AI so you can iterate. Be ready to learn the details and act on the fly.

scenes.label: CHAPTER 3
scenes.title: What it costs and how long it takes
scenes.broll: Cost and timeline graphic: £1,500 + £2,100, 2 months before + 2 months after
scenes.vo: Here's what it costs: a £1,500 deposit, then a £2,100 balance to the liquidation company to close the business. This is the place that I found. There could be cheaper or more expensive options, but you need to plan for it. The process before took me two months, and after the payment I expect two more months to complete. You plus AI gives you leverage. Learn and act on the fly, build your skills, and carry them over to your next project.

scenes.label: CHAPTER 4
scenes.title: The exceptions
scenes.broll: Exceptions cards, security guardrail badge, hands-on AI loop
scenes.vo: Now the exceptions, because this matters. ⚠️ The protection isn't absolute. When I stopped paying the accountant, I felt isolated, and AI was the place to turn to. This is what I learned from AI. But AI systems aren't hands-off: you are hands-on to secure, adapt and train them. The insolvency practitioner is your security guardrail 🛡️, so be sure on your end when inputting data to them. Personal liability remains for wrongful trading, personal guarantees, or director loan accounts.
overlay: ⚠️ The Exceptions & Personal Liability

🛠️ Not hands-off: you are hands-on to secure, adapt & train AI
🛡️ Licensed Practitioner = Essential Security Guardrail
🚫 Wrongful trading · Personal guarantees · Overdrawn loan accounts

scenes.label: CHAPTER 5
scenes.title: What my emails taught me
scenes.broll: Online methods as database animation, MCP connection pipeline
scenes.vo: Three lessons from my emails and records. One: the process stops until the balance is paid—my provider chased me six times. Two: use online methods and keep everything in writing, because online records act as databases. Three: connect your drive and emails to AI over MCP. When things go wrong, learn from them and iterate.
overlay: 📧 Lessons from Emails & Records
1️⃣ Process stops until paid (chased 6 times ⏳)
2️⃣ Use online methods: they act as structured databases 🗄️
3️⃣ Connect Gmail & Drive to AI over MCP ⚡
🔄 Learn from every issue and iterate

scenes.label: CHAPTER 6
scenes.title: How I keep track of it
scenes.broll: n8n deterministic cron email vs AI probabilistic reply workflow diagram, Friend's advice vs honour card
scenes.vo: I keep track of it all with n8n and AI agents. Remember: n8n is deterministic and known, while AI is probabilistic and unknown. Build your process around both. A friend told me: become like MrBeast, why show your real work? Have the honour to do what's right and share what you're genuinely working on. Build your system and mindset for the next journey.

🏗️ Build your workflow process around both
